name: Test of Lore
label: Quest

intro: Following trials of faith, endurance, and strength in Thousand Needles, Dorn Plainstalker directs Horde champions northward to Stonetalon Mountains. There, a wise shaman named Braug Dimspirit waits to administer the Test of Lore. This trial shifts the focus from physical resolve to an understanding of the world's deep history and widespread suffering.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.
If you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, friend.
When you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, friend, the night elves may wish to impede your test.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.
